description: A LightningJS component called 'NotesList' that manages and displays a list of notes, with functions for creating notes, updating selection, and rendering the UI.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: LightningJS component managing notes list, selection, creation, and rendering.

methods.name: _syncFromStore
methods.description: Synchronizes component state from the global store, sorting notes by update or creation time, and setting the focused index.

methods.name: createNote
methods.description: Public method to add a new empty note via the store.

methods.name: _moveSelection
methods.description: Changes the selected note index by a delta and updates the store with the new selection.
